system_a.summary: Across 100 reviews, guests consistently praise this studio apartment at the back of the host Christal's home for its charming, artistic decor, cleanliness, and very comfortable bed. Recent reviews (2024–2026) repeat these themes: a walkable downtown location, nearby Whole Foods and other groceries, easy parking, a quiet setting, a garden patio or porch, and a responsive, helpful host. Guests describe it as best suited to one or two people. Limitations appeared mostly in older reviews: thin walls shared with the main house, with dog barking and music noted in 2019; a bright neighboring security light in 2016; no thermostat control and a lukewarm bathtub in 2020; and a neighborhood described as still changing in 2023. Walking time to downtown was reported as roughly 5–20 minutes. No recent reviews reported significant problems, though these are guest reports, not verified current conditions.

system_b.summary: Guests across 2015–2026, including 2024–2026 stays, describe a walkable location near downtown Asheville, with groceries, coffee, breweries and restaurants close; walking times vary from about 5 to 20 minutes, and a 2016 guest suggested a car for farther trips. Cleanliness is praised consistently from 2016 through 2026, and many reviewers cite a comfortable, cozy space suited to one or two people. Reported amenities include a kitchenette, a patio or porch and easy parking, though a 2020 guest said the tub water would not run hot. Noise reports conflict: a 2019 guest described barking and bass music and unclear shared-home disclosure, while others, through 2026, found it quiet. Single older reports mention a 2016 security light and 2020 temperature control issues; current status is unknown. Safety comments from 2020–2023 are mixed, and none are from 2024–2026.

selected_claims.claim: Guests overwhelmingly describe the location as walkable to downtown Asheville, with Whole Foods and other grocery stores, coffee, breweries and restaurants very close. Reports span 2015 to 2026, including recent stays. One 2016 guest put the walk to the center of downtown at about 20 minutes and suggested a car for exploring further.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Consistent across 2015-2026; recent reviews in 2024-2026 repeat it.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Walking times vary by reviewer (5 to 20 minutes); one 2016 reviewer gave a mixed view.

selected_claims.claim: Cleanliness is praised very consistently, with many guests calling the unit very or super clean. No cleanliness complaints appear in the ledger.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Based on guest-reported impressions, not verified inspections.

selected_claims.claim: Many guests report a comfortable bed, linens and furniture and a cozy, well-decorated space. The unit is repeatedly described as suited to one or two people.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Suitability for larger groups is not addressed in the evidence.

selected_claims.claim: Guests report a well-equipped kitchenette, tea and coffee, toiletries, a back porch or patio and easy or free parking. One 2020 guest said the bathtub water would not run hot, though the shower was hot.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Praise spans 2015-2026; the tub complaint dates from 2020.
selected_claims.uncertainty: The tub issue is a single report. No evidence shows whether it persists.

selected_claims.claim: The unit is attached to or part of the host's home, and walls may be thin. A 2019 guest reported dogs barking and loud bass music from the other side of the house, and said the shared setup was unclear at booking. The same guest said noise was not a major issue and they slept fine. Other guests, mostly in 2016-2026, call it quiet, and a 2019 guest said noise was no problem. A sound machine is provided.
selected_claims.time_qualification: The noise and disclosure complaint is from 2019. Quiet reports continue through 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Only one reviewer reported noise, and no evidence shows whether it recurred. Noise likely depends on what the host and household are doing at the time.

selected_claims.claim: A 2016 guest reported a bright neighboring security light that cycled on and off all night and lit the bedroom. A 2020 guest could not adjust the unit's temperature, which they believed was controlled from the main house, and it got warm.
selected_claims.uncertainty: No later mentions, so current status is unknown.

selected_claims.claim: The host is described as responsive, communicative and helpful, with local recommendations and quick help during a 2023 lockout. Check-in is generally easy, with clear instructions and a private entrance. One 2023 guest accidentally locked themselves out.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Reported across 2015-2026; the lockout was in 2023.
selected_claims.uncertainty: The lockout appears to be guest error, not a property defect.

selected_claims.claim: Guests generally say the listing matches photos and description. One 2019 guest said it was unclear at booking that the unit is one side of the host's home.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Accuracy praise from 2015 to 2025; the disclosure complaint is from 2019.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Other guests mention the host's home without objecting, but the current listing wording is not shown.

selected_claims.claim: The neighborhood is called quiet and safe, and guests reported feeling comfortable walking at night. A 2023 reviewer said it is in transition, with some properties needing work, and that some guests might be uncomfortable. One 2022 reviewer noted an alternative route that avoids going under a bridge, without saying why.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Reports from 2020-2023; no recent safety reports in 2024-2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Few reviewers commented on safety, and neither the bridge concern nor the neighborhood change is clarified.
